scenarios.title: An Aura's enchant ability restricts what it can target: Enchant land cannot target a creature
decisions: A tries to cast Wild Growth targeting Grizzly Bears, paying G with a Forest.

variants.label: target_creature
variants.expected: The cast is illegal: Grizzly Bears is not a legal target for Wild Growth (enchant land).

variants.label: target_land
variants.delta: A targets the untapped Forest instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The cast is legal. Wild Growth resolves and enters attached to that Forest.

scenarios.title: An Aura with Enchant creature has no legal target when there is no creature
decisions: A tries to cast Guard Duty, paying W with Plains.

variants.label: no_creature
variants.expected: Guard Duty has no legal target and cannot be cast; the verdict reports no legal target.

variants.label: creature_present
variants.expected: Guard Duty has Grizzly Bears as its only legal target; the cast is legal and Guard Duty resolves attached to Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.title: An Aura that enchants a player targets players and not permanents
decisions: A casts Curse of the Pierced Heart targeting player B, tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; the Aura resolves.

variants.label: target_player
variants.expected: The cast is legal. Curse of the Pierced Heart resolves and enters attached to player B.

variants.label: target_creature
variants.delta: A targets Grizzly Bears instead of player B.
variants.expected: The cast is illegal: Grizzly Bears is not a legal target for an Aura that enchants a player.
